abilities.effect: The shrieker emits a deafening screech that deals 1d6 sonic damage to creatures within 30 feet (DC 16 basic Fortitude save; creatures that critically fail this saving throw are deafened for 1 minute).
abilities.name: Shriek
abilities.trigger: A creature or light source approaches within 10 feet of the shrieker or the shrieker takes damage

hazard.description: This human-sized purple mushroom emits a piercing shriek when disturbed.
hazard.disable: DC 18 Survival to carefully approach and cut the mushroom’s air sac without triggering the shrieker
hazard.name: Shrieker

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.

traits.name: Fungus
traits.text: Fungal creatures have the fungus trait. They are distinct from normal fungi.
